note: Same labelling rule as relevance-a.json. Note the asymmetry in abstention cases: Brambleside has nine questions with no evidence, Northgate two. That is a property of the documents rather than of the labelling — Northgate's own papers record a long list of governance gaps (no evaluation ever, no skills matrix, no conflicts register, no internal audit), and a recorded absence IS evidence a consultant would put in front of a respondent. It is also why the abstention cutoff cannot be measured on labelled questions alone: see the leave-one-document-out construction in scripts/check-retrieval.ts.
